functions.name: Requirements and evaluation
functions.authority_inference_limit: Evaluation is not final selection authority.

functions.name: Sponsorship and change ownership
functions.authority_inference_limit: Sponsorship does not establish budget or signature.

functions.name: Service and result ownership
functions.authority_inference_limit: Title alone does not identify the owner; result remains separate from release.

functions.name: Funding and resources
functions.authority_inference_limit: Approved budget is not realised spend or contractual commitment.

functions.name: Proposal or stage authorisation
functions.authority_inference_limit: Authority is scoped to a decision and date, not unrestricted future changes.

functions.name: Commercial process
functions.authority_inference_limit: Tender management does not establish business ownership or final vote.

functions.name: Contractual commitment
functions.authority_inference_limit: Signature does not establish initiation, evaluation or budget ownership.

functions.name: Specialist advice and assurance
functions.authority_inference_limit: Establish any additional binding condition or stop power separately.

functions.name: Delivery
functions.authority_inference_limit: Executing work does not establish selection or approval authority.

functions.name: Operational acceptance and release
functions.authority_inference_limit: Functional signoff is not necessarily full go-live or investment approval.

functions.name: Escalation and exception
functions.authority_inference_limit: Seniority alone does not establish escalation authority.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Effective remit and change
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Requested role scope, described delegation, effective period/change and actual exercise
cross_cutting_conditions.limits: An intended role or unchanged title is not effective delegated authority. Preserve interim/succession/handback where relevant.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Organisation and contract level
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Broad employer/external party, group/region/entity/country and service or agreement scope
cross_cutting_conditions.limits: Do not demand entity names or a complete corporate chart, or transfer framework/group rights to every customer/local decision.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Mandate and practice
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Mandate as described, action directly taken/observed, any reported difference/change and knowledge basis
cross_cutting_conditions.limits: Practical control alone does not establish formal delegation, misconduct or motive. Preserve divergent accounts.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Acceptance object
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Hours for payment, deliverable, handover, payroll result, readiness, supplier choice or contract commitment
cross_cutting_conditions.limits: Application/time approval, output acceptance and purchasing authority are not interchangeable; actual scope governs.

cross_cutting_conditions.name: Affected-party or external condition
cross_cutting_conditions.establish: Actual change and any relevant representation/agreement/specialist/external condition, its applicability owner basis and state
cross_cutting_conditions.limits: No universal employee veto, automatic processing consent or mandatory consultation route for every software change. Current context and final-use guidance check required.
